1.0.0 Arazzo 1.1.0 http://127.0.0.1:4175/examples/digital-product/arazzo.yaml

A small fictional purchase journey with explicit downstream workflow composition.

A client purchases a digital product, retrieves its ready license and reports the actual device activation outcome. The coordinator reserves inventory, captures the authorized payment and issues one license before returning the purchase response. Client exchanges and coordinator implementation are separate perspectives of the same purchase exchange. All API contracts are local; example.test servers and authorization tokens are illustrative.
